title: Formation of gp37 LTF needle trimers-OmpC complex
author: Mohammad Z. Islam

steps_raw.instruction: Formation of gp37 LTF needle trimers-OmpC complex

Coat wells of a flat-bottomed 96-well microtiter plate (Maxisorp, Nunc, Thermo Fisher Scientific) (columns 1 to 10) in duplicate with gp37 LTF needle trimers (100 ng in 100 µl/well) in coating buffer (0.05 M carbonate-bicarbonate buffer, pH 9.6). For standard curve, coat serially diluted known concentration of OmpC protein in columns 11 and 12 in the same coating buffer. Incubate the plate overnight at 4°C.
Wash the plate two times with phosphate buffer saline containing 0.05 Tween 20 (PBS-T), 250 µl per well.
Block the wells with 1X casein blocking buffer (Sigma Aldrich, St. Louis, MO), 200 µl per well, for 2 hr at room temperature.
Add OmpC to the wells (columns 1 to 10) at a gp37:OmpC molar ratio of 1:1, or PBS (column 11 and 12) and incubate at 37°C for 2 hr.
After washing 4 times with PBS-T, add anti-OmpC mouse sera at a dilution of 1:5,000 and incubate the plates for 1 hr at 37ºC.

Wash four times with PBS-T (250 µl per well), add 100 µl of 1: 5,000 diluted horseradish peroxidase (HRP)-conjugated rabbit anti-mouse IgG (Invitrogen, Camarillo, CA) to each well and incubate at 37°C for 1 hr.
After washing four times with PBS-T (250 µl per well), add 100 µl of TMB (3,3’,5,5’-tetramethylbenzidine) substrate in each well and incubate for 25 min at room temperature to develop the color.
Measure the absorbance at 650 nm using an ELISA reader (VERSA max, Molecular Devices).
Determine the concentration of bound OmpC from the standard curve constructed for each plate with serially diluted known concentrations of OmpC incubated with anti-OmpC antibody.
